classification.resume: This is a television news report from the Swiss public broadcaster SRG SSR, broadcast on 31 August 1977 as part of the Tagesschau program. It features dental hygienists demonstrating proper flossing techniques and includes a statement from Thomas Marthaler, head of the University of Zurich's Dental Institute, discussing dental health and the impact of sugary foods versus healthy foods on teeth. The segment uses graphics to illustrate childhood and adult tooth decay.
